title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Invoice Due Dates, Late Payment Fees and Payment Application
content:
Each monthly invoice of a Bluegate Business Storage Account falls due under the program's invoice terms, and a late payment fee may follow when it is not paid by then.

## Rule

**Due date.** An invoice is due the program's invoice terms, in calendar days, after its invoice date. Term days are calendar days counted from the day after the invoice date, and a payment on the last day is on time. Invoice terms of 0 make the invoice due on its invoice date.

**When a fee may be charged.** A late payment fee may be charged only when the handling date is later than the invoice date plus the program's invoice terms in days — that is, only when the date on which the matter is handled falls after the last day of the invoice terms. On the last day itself no fee may be charged. The invoice date is the date of that invoice in the company's records, and the fee is charged against that invoice.

**Amount.** The fee is the greater of the program's late payment percentage of the unpaid invoice amount and the program's minimum late payment fee. It is charged once per invoice.

**Payment application.** Payments are applied to the oldest invoice month first.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical invoices)

| Invoice date | Invoice terms | Last day on which payment is on time | Handling date | Fee may be charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 days | 16 March | 16 March | No — not later than the last day |
| 1 March | 15 days | 16 March | 17 March | Yes |
| 1 March | 0 days | 1 March | 1 March | No |
| 1 March | 0 days | 1 March | 2 March | Yes |
| 1 April | 30 days | 1 May | 2 May | Yes |

Counting for the last row: 2 April is term day 1, 30 April is term day 29 and 1 May is term day 30.

## Fee amounts (hypothetical rate of 1.5% and minimum of $15.00)

| Unpaid amount of the invoice | 1.5% of it | Minimum | Fee charged (the greater) |
|---|---|---|---|
| $600.00 | $9.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 |
| $1000.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 |
| $2000.00 | $30.00 | $15.00 | $30.00 |

## Payment application illustrated (hypothetical)

An account has a January invoice of $100.00 and a February invoice of $100.00, both unpaid. A payment of $150.00 is applied first to January, clearing it, and the remaining $50.00 to February, leaving $50.00 unpaid on the February invoice. The unpaid amount of the February invoice is then $50.00, and that is the amount the percentage is taken of. A January invoice already charged its late payment fee is not charged a second one.
